# Vendored @noble modules

Generated by `scripts/vendor-noble.mjs`. Do not edit these files; run
`npm run vendor` after changing a @noble version and commit the result.

@noble's published ESM imports its own modules by package specifier, which
a browser cannot resolve and an import map cannot fix here, because the
gateway's Content-Security-Policy has no `'unsafe-inline'`. These copies
differ from upstream only in those specifiers, which are made relative.

Each package is MIT licensed; its LICENSE is copied alongside the code.

- `hashes/` — 7 file(s) from @noble/hashes@1.4.0, reachable from `esm/argon2.js` (imported by `js/core/kdf.js`)
- `ciphers/` — 5 file(s) from @noble/ciphers@1.2.1, reachable from `esm/chacha.js` (imported by `js/core/suites.js`)
